questions.question: (93 + 14) - 56 times 2 + 33 + 15 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve the brackets and basic operations in chunks.

(93 + 14) = 107

56 × 2 = 112

33 + 15 = 48

107 − 112 + 48 = −5 + 48 = 43

**∴ The correct answer is 43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: (93 + 14) − 56 × 2 + 33 + 15

Follow the BODMAS rule (Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction):

⇒ 107 − 56 × 2 + 33 + 15 (Solving the bracket: 93 + 14 = 107)

⇒ 107 − 112 + 33 + 15 (Solving multiplication: 56 × 2 = 112)

⇒ 107 + 33 + 15 − 112 (Grouping positive terms for addition)

⇒ 155 − 112 (Addition: 107 + 33 + 15 = 155)

⇒ 43 (Final subtraction)

**∴ The correct answer is 43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS/VBODMAS Rule

It defines the sequence of solving mathematical expressions: Vinculum, Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Grouping Symbols

Operations inside Parentheses (), Curly brackets {}, or Square brackets [] must be prioritized before outside operations.

Left-to-Right Execution

For operations at the same priority level (like Addition and Subtraction), always calculate from left to right to ensure accuracy.

questions.question: 55 + 61 - 43 + (28 + 19) times 2 - 57 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve using the BODMAS priority (Brackets first, then Multiplication).

Bracket: (28 + 19) = 47

Multiplication: 47 × 2 = 94

Final Calculation: 55 + 61 − 43 + 94 − 57 = 110

**∴ The correct answer is 110.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

55 + 61 − 43 + (28 + 19) × 2 − 57

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS rule: B → Brackets, O → Of, D → Division, M → Multiplication, A → Addition, S → Subtraction.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 55 + 61 − 43 + (47) × 2 − 57

⇒ 55 + 61 − 43 + 94 − 57

⇒ 116 − 43 + 94 − 57

⇒ 73 + 94 − 57

⇒ 167 − 57

⇒ 110

**∴ The correct answer is 110.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

The rule defines the order of operations to solve complex mathematical expressions correctly.

Addition and Subtraction Priority

Addition and subtraction have the same priority level and should be solved from left to right in the expression.

Multiplication Shortcut

Always multiply before adding or subtracting values outside of brackets to avoid calculation errors.

questions.question: 74 - 48 + 39 { of } 2 + 27 div 3 - (18 times 1) + 16 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply VBODMAS rule to prioritize operations: Brackets → Of → Division → Multiplication → Addition → Subtraction.

74 − 48 + (39 × 2) + (27 ÷ 3) − 18 + 16

74 − 48 + 78 + 9 − 18 + 16

Grouping positive and negative terms: (74 + 78 + 9 + 16) − (48 + 18) = 177 − 66 = 111.

**∴ The correct answer is 111.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 74 − 48 + 39 of 2 + 27 ÷ 3 − (18 × 1) + 16

**Formula Used:** BODMAS rule

⇒ 74 − 48 + 39 of 2 + 27 ÷ 3 − 18 + 16 (Solving Brackets)

⇒ 74 − 48 + 78 + 27 ÷ 3 − 18 + 16 (Solving Of: 39 × 2 = 78)

⇒ 74 − 48 + 78 + 9 − 18 + 16 (Solving Division: 27 ÷ 3 = 9)

⇒ (74 + 78 + 9 + 16) − 48 − 18 (Grouping Addition)

⇒ 177 − 48 − 18 (Solving Addition)

⇒ 177 − 66 = 111 (Solving Subtraction)

**∴ The correct answer is 111.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It specifies the order of operations: Brackets (), Orders/Of, Division (÷), Multiplication (×), Addition (+), and Subtraction (−).

Of Operator

In mathematical expressions, "of" acts as a multiplication but must be performed before division and standard multiplication.

Vinculum (V-BODMAS)

A horizontal line (bar) over numbers indicates they must be solved first, even before standard brackets.

questions.question: 76 + 41 - 24 + 38 div 2 + (27 { of } 1) - 36 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve components using BODMAS priority order.

(27 of 1) = 27 and 38 ÷ 2 = 19.

Group terms: (76 + 41 + 19 + 27) − (24 + 36).

163 − 60 = 103.

**∴ The correct answer is 103.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: 76 + 41 − 24 + 38 ÷ 2 + (27 of 1) − 36

Formula used: BODMAS (Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ 76 + 41 − 24 + 38 ÷ 2 + 27 − 36

⇒ 76 + 41 − 24 + 19 + 27 − 36

⇒ 117 − 24 + 19 + 27 − 36

⇒ 93 + 19 + 27 − 36

⇒ 112 + 27 − 36

⇒ 139 − 36

⇒ 103

**∴ The correct answer is 103.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

VBODMAS Rule

It defines the sequence of operations: Viniculum, Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

'Of' Operator

The 'of' operator is treated as multiplication but holds a higher priority than division and multiplication operators.

Grouping Technique

Summing all positive values together and all negative values together separately minimizes calculation errors in long expressions.

questions.question:
The pie chart given below shows the number of students studying in 5 sections of a class. The data is presented in the terms of degrees.

Total number of students studying in section C and D = 400 .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/204c935cab038de78e0c71df2dc5dfe2580337fe58b4872e1b224f9a10d764e6.png] 

Number of students studying in E are what percent of number of students studying in D?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 
 

 Class Section
 Central Angle (Degrees)
 
 

 Section A
 108°
 
 

 Section B
 54°
 
 

 Section C
 90°
 
 

 Section D
 36°
 
 

 Section E
 72°
 
 

 **Total**
 **360°**
 
 

Total number of students in section C and D = 400

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Value ÷ Base Value) × 100

Since the number of students in each section is directly proportional to the central angle, the percentage can be calculated using the degrees directly.

Required Percentage = (Degrees of Section E ÷ Degrees of Section D) × 100

**Calculation:**

According to the data extracted from the pie chart,

⇒ Central angle for Section E = 72°

⇒ Central angle for Section D = 36°

⇒ Required Percentage = (72° ÷ 36°) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 2 × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 200%

∴ The correct answer is 200%.

questions.question: A, B, and C can do a job in 12, 15, and 20 days, respectively. All three work together for 4 days. Then A leaves; B and C continue, but at only 3/4 of their normal daily hours. How many more days are needed to finish?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(12, 15, 20) = 60 units.

Efficiencies: A = 5, B = 4, C = 3. Total (A+B+C) = 12.

Work done in 4 days = 12 × 4 = 48 units.

Remaining work = 60 − 48 = 12 units.

B and C reduced efficiency = (4 + 3) × 3/4 = 21/4.

Extra days needed = 12 ÷ (21/4) = 48/21 = 16/7 = 2 2/7 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 2/7 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 12 days

Time taken by B = 15 days

Time taken by C = 20 days

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 12
 60
 5
 
 

 B
 15
 4
 
 

 C
 20
 3
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of (A + B + C) = 5 + 4 + 3 = 12 units/day

⇒ Work completed in 4 days = 12 × 4 = 48 units

⇒ Remaining work = 60 − 48 = 12 units

⇒ Normal efficiency of (B + C) = 4 + 3 = 7 units/day

⇒ Since they work at 3/4 of normal daily hours, New efficiency = 7 × 3/4 = 21/4 units/day

⇒ Days required to finish = Remaining Work ÷ New Efficiency

⇒ Time = 12 ÷ (21/4) = (12 × 4) / 21 = 48 / 21

⇒ Time = 16 / 7 = 2 2/7 days

**∴ The correct answer is 2 2/7 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the work done by each individual, which is Efficiency × Time.

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete the work (Efficiency = 1 / Time).

Pipes and Cisterns

Concept is identical to Time and Work, where outlet pipes have negative efficiency and inlet pipes have positive efficiency.

questions.question: In an election, there were only two candidates. One of the candidates secured 30\% of the votes and was defeated by the other candidate by 3,65,104 votes. What is the total number of votes polled?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a two-candidate election, winner votes % = 100% − 30% = 70%

Difference in percentage = 70% − 30% = 40%

Given: 40% of total votes = 3,65,104

Total votes (100%) = (3,65,104 ÷ 40) × 100 = 912760

**∴ The correct answer is 912760.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69718315a87ce419ed5f51a6bd41c4a953392a34407880373ed20d1f4f446a93.png] 

Given: Votes secured by loser = 30% | Margin of defeat = 3,65,104

⇒ Let the total number of votes polled be V.

⇒ Votes secured by winner = (100 − 30)% = 70%

⇒ Victory margin in percentage = 70% − 30% = 40%

⇒ 40% of V = 3,65,104

⇒ (40 ÷ 100) × V = 3,65,104

⇒ V = (3,65,104 × 100) ÷ 40

⇒ V = 9,127.6 × 100

⇒ V = 9,12,760

**∴ The correct answer is 912760.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Vote Distribution

In a simple two-candidate election, total valid votes = Winner votes + Loser votes. The win/loss margin is the difference between these two shares.

Percentage to Absolute Value

To find the total value (base) when the difference is given: Total = (Difference value ÷ Difference in percentage) × 100.

Invalid Votes Consideration

If invalid votes are present, Candidate % is usually calculated on valid votes. Total Polled = Valid Votes + Invalid Votes.

questions.question: A lender lends Rs. 10,000 at 8\% per annum simple interest for t years and then lends an additional Rs. 5,000 at 12\% per annum simple interest for the same period t . If the total simple interest at the end of t years is 5,400 , find t (in years).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total annual interest = (10000 × 8%) + (5000 × 12%)

Annual Interest = 800 + 600 = ₹1400

Total time t = Total Simple Interest ÷ Annual Interest

t = 5400 ÷ 1400 = 27 ÷ 7 ≈ 3.86 years

**∴ The correct answer is 3.86 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Principal₁ (P₁) = ₹10,000, Rate₁ (R₁) = 8%

Given: Principal₂ (P₂) = ₹5,000, Rate₂ (R₂) = 12%

Total Simple Interest (SI) = ₹5,400, Time = t years

Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/830e863a178474868565d0bee94947fe5ceac6d1deedb2f974638dc78b857f19.png] 

⇒ SI₁ = (10000 × 8 × t) ÷ 100 = 800t

⇒ SI₂ = (5000 × 12 × t) ÷ 100 = 600t

⇒ Total SI = SI₁ + SI₂

⇒ 5400 = 800t + 600t

⇒ 5400 = 1400t

⇒ t = 5400 ÷ 1400

⇒ t = 54 ÷ 14 = 27 ÷ 7

⇒ t ≈ 3.86 years

**∴ The correct answer is 3.86 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI) Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is Principal, R is Rate per annum, and T is Time in years.

Total Amount Formula

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI) = P × (1 + (R × T) ÷ 100).

Effective Rate of Interest

When multiple investments are made, the combined rate Rₑff = (ΣPᵢRᵢ) ÷ ΣPᵢ.

questions.question: A man borrowed Rs. 18,000 at 10\% per annum simple interest. After 3 years, he repaid the borrowed money along with the interest by giving a motorcycle worth 12,000 and the remaining in cash. Find the amount of cash he paid.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Simple Interest rate for 3 years = 10% × 3 = 30%

Total Payable Amount = 130% of 18,000 = ₹23,400

Cash to be paid = Total Amount − Motorcycle value

Cash = 23,400 − 12,000 = ₹11,400

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹18,000

Rate (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

Value of Motorcycle = ₹12,000

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Total Amount (A) = Principal + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9458fad0eca0b08bc850d19409b2d43367dc9c4e7a22bdc066c31e46cf6a5a28.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (18,000 × 10 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 180 × 30

⇒ SI = ₹5,400

⇒ Total Amount = 18,000 + 5,400

⇒ Total Amount = ₹23,400

⇒ Cash Paid = Total Amount − Motorcycle Value

⇒ Cash Paid = 23,400 − 12,000

⇒ Cash Paid = ₹11,400

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

For the first year, SI and CI are always equal if the interest is compounded annually on the same principal and rate.

Effective Rate of Interest

The effective rate for simple interest over 'T' years is (R ×T)%. In this case, 10 × 3 = 30%.

Total Amount Formula

Amount can also be calculated as A = P(1 + RT/100). Here, A = 18000(1 + 30/100) = 18000 × 1.3 = ₹23,400.

questions.question: Manju sold a scooty with a tagged price of ₹1,25,000 . After applying a trade concession, the final transaction value became ₹70,000 . Calculate the percentage discount given on the marked price.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Tagged Price (MP) to Transaction Value (SP) = 1,25,000 : 70,000 = 125 : 70 = 25 : 14.

Discount units = 25 − 14 = 11 units.

Discount % = (Discount units ÷ MP units) × 100 = (11 ÷ 25) × 100.

Discount % = 11 × 4 = 44%.

**∴ The correct answer is 44%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Tagged Price (Marked Price) = ₹1,25,000

Final Transaction Value (Selling Price) = ₹70,000

**Formula Used:**

Discount % = [ (Marked Price − Selling Price) ÷ Marked Price ] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77fe5f23a6bfcbc52d6a4c12422ed93993356a57344cdcac19b810600348eb65.png] 

⇒ Discount = ₹1,25,000 − ₹70,000

⇒ Discount = ₹55,000

⇒ Discount % = (55,000 ÷ 1,25,000) × 100

⇒ Discount % = (55 ÷ 125) × 100

⇒ Discount % = (11 ÷ 25) × 100

⇒ Discount % = 11 × 4 = 44%

**∴ The correct answer is 44%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the single equivalent discount is (a + b − ab/100)%.

Markup Percentage

It is the percentage by which the cost price is increased to reach the marked price: Markup % = [(MP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100.

Selling Price Formula

SP can be calculated directly using MP and discount: SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100.

questions.question: A trader buys an article at ₹3,500 and marks it up by 35\% . He gives two successive discounts of 20\% and 10\% . What is his net profit or loss percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net multiplier = (1 + Mark-up%) × (1 − d₁%) × (1 − d₂%)

Net multiplier = 1.35 × 0.80 × 0.90 = 1.35 × 0.72 = 0.972

Net Percentage = 0.972 × 100 = 97.2%

Since 97.2% [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Cost Price (CP) = ₹3,500 | Mark-up = 35% | Successive Discounts = 20% and 10%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd66a98287546122254b42177a83df6eaf2d9833a9e8f6c86a0aff911c5db172.png] 

⇒ Marked Price (MP) = 3500 + 35% of 3500

⇒ MP = 3500 + (35/100) × 3500 = 3500 + 1225 = ₹4,725

⇒ After 1st Discount (20%): Price = 4725 − (20/100) × 4725 = 4725 − 945 = ₹3,780

⇒ After 2nd Discount (10%): SP = 3780 − (10/100) × 3780 = 3780 − 378 = ₹3,402

⇒ Total Loss = CP − SP = 3500 − 3402 = ₹98

⇒ Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100 = (98 ÷ 3500) × 100 = 2.8%

**∴ The correct answer is Loss of 2.8%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the equivalent single discount is (a + b − ab/100)%.

Relationship between CP and MP

MP/CP = (100 + Profit%) / (100 − Discount%). If there is a loss, use (100 − Loss%).

Net Percentage Change

The final result is independent of the actual value of CP if only the percentage profit/loss is required.

questions.question: Two cars start from the same point at the same time, moving in the same direction. The first car travels at 60 km/h, and the second car at 90 km/h. After how much time will they be 45 km apart?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed (same direction) = Speed₂ − Speed₁

Relative speed = 90 − 60 = 30 km/h

Time required = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Time = 45 ÷ 30 = 1.5 hours = 1 hour 30 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 1 hour 30 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Speed of Car 1 = 60 km/h, Speed of Car 2 = 90 km/h, Target separation distance = 45 km.

Formula: Relative Speed (Same direction) = Vₕᵢgₕ − Vₗₒw | Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ceaab8d58dce4f44cb9a6ae4d14f4656dff2eab7e793beab489e44eef96d0e71.png] 

⇒ Relative Speed = 90 − 60 = 30 km/h

⇒ This means the distance between the cars increases by 30 km every hour.

⇒ Time taken to reach 45 km distance = 45 ÷ 30

⇒ Time = 1.5 hours

⇒ 1.5 hours = 1 hour + (0.5 × 60) minutes = 1 hour 30 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 1 hour 30 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Opposite Directions

When two objects move towards each other or away from each other in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Vᵣₑₗ = V₁ + V₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply the speed by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Time, Speed, and Distance Relation

Distance = Speed × Time. If distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time (S ∝ 1/T).

questions.question: Two cyclists start at the same time from towns A and B, which are 210 km apart, and travel towards each other. The cyclist from A rides at 28 km/h, and the cyclist from B rides at 32 km/h. Find the time (in hours) taken by the cyclist from B to reach town A after meeting.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time for B after meeting = (Speed of A × Distance between towns) ÷ [Speed of B × (Speed of A + Speed of B)]

Relative speed = 28 + 32 = 60 km/h

Time for B to reach A after meeting = (28 × 210) ÷ (32 × 60)

Time = (28 × 3.5) ÷ 32 = 98 ÷ 32 = 3.0625 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 3.06 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Distance (D) = 210 km

Speed of cyclist A (VA) = 28 km/h

Speed of cyclist B (VB) = 32 km/h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cf702b5d3929bd4dcc63fb973748600aa86139e6a213853fa738efaf5f355ea.png] 

⇒ Relative Speed (Towards each other) = VA + VB

⇒ Relative Speed = 28 + 32 = 60 km/h

⇒ Time taken to meet (tₘ) = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ tₘ = 210 ÷ 60 = 3.5 hours

⇒ Distance covered by A until meeting (AM) = VA × tₘ

⇒ AM = 28 × 3.5 = 98 km

⇒ After meeting at point M, cyclist B must cover distance MA to reach town A.

⇒ Time taken by B to cover MA = Distance MA ÷ Speed of B

⇒ Time = 98 ÷ 32 = 3.0625 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 3.06 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two objects move towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Meeting Point Time

The time at which two objects starting simultaneously meet is given by t = Distance ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

After Meeting Formula

If two objects reach their destinations in time T₁ and T₂ after meeting, the ratio of speeds is V₁/V₂ = √(T₂/T₁).

questions.question: Two cyclists start from two towns, A and B , which are 180 km apart, and move towards each other. The cyclist from A rides at 40 km/h, while the cyclist from B rides at 50 km/h. However, the cyclist from A starts 45 minutes earlier. Find the time (in hours, rounded to two decimals) after A 's start when they meet.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance covered by A in 45 min = 40 × (45 ÷ 60) = 30 km.

Remaining distance to be covered by A and B together = 180 − 30 = 150 km.

Relative speed of A and B = 40 + 50 = 90 kmph.

Time taken to meet after B starts = 150 ÷ 90 = 1.67 h.

Total time from A's start = 0.75 + 1.67 = 2.42 h.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.42 h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 180 km

Speed of cyclist A = 40 kmph | Speed of cyclist B = 50 kmph

Time head-start for A = 45 minutes = 0.75 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = Speed₁ + Speed₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/670c2e805ab15aa5aacd1deacc3dc358b11d880aab780348a3fea60814e0958f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance covered by A before B starts = 40 × (45 ÷ 60) = 30 km

⇒ Remaining distance between A and B = 180 − 30 = 150 km

⇒ Combined speed (Relative speed) = 40 + 50 = 90 kmph

⇒ Time taken to meet after B starts = 150 ÷ 90 = 1.666... hours ≈ 1.67 h

⇒ Total time after A's start = Time head-start + Time after B starts

⇒ Total time = 0.75 + 1.666... = 2.4166... h

⇒ Rounded to two decimals = 2.42 h

**∴ The correct answer is 2.42 h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concepts

When moving in opposite directions, relative speed is S₁ + S₂. When moving in the same direction, relative speed is |S₁ − S₂|.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from kmph to m/s, multiply by 5 ÷ 18. To convert m/s to kmph, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

Average Speed for Entire Journey

If distances are equal, Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂). Otherwise, use Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Group integers and fractions: (99 + 99 + 90) + (1/5 + 4/5 + 1/5)

Sum of integers = 288

Sum of fractions = 6/5 = 1 + 1/5

Total = 288 + 1 + 1/5 = 289 1/5

**∴ The correct answer is 289 1/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: 99 1/5 + 99 4/5 + 90 1/5

Formula used: a b/c = a + (b/c)

⇒ (99 + 1/5) + (99 + 4/5) + (90 + 1/5)

⇒ (99 + 99 + 90) + (1/5 + 4/5 + 1/5)

⇒ 288 + (1 + 4 + 1)/5

⇒ 288 + 6/5

⇒ 288 + 1 1/5

⇒ 289 1/5

**∴ The correct answer is 289 1/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mixed Fraction Addition

A mixed fraction is the sum of an integer and a proper fraction. They can be added by summing the whole numbers and fractional parts separately.

Improper Fraction Conversion

An improper fraction (numerator > denominator) like 6/5 is converted to a mixed fraction 1 1/5 by dividing the numerator by the denominator.

Like Fractions

Fractions with the same denominator are called like fractions. Their sum is (sum of numerators) ÷ (common denominator).

questions.question: ((3.5)³ - (0.5)³ - 8.75)/((3.5)² - (0.5)² - 3.5) = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Evaluate the numerator: 3.5³ − 0.5³ − 8.75 = 42.875 − 0.125 − 8.75 = 34

Evaluate the denominator: 3.5² − 0.5² − 3.5 = 12.25 − 0.25 − 3.5 = 8.5

Required Value = 34 ÷ 8.5 = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: [(3.5)³ − (0.5)³ − 8.75] ÷ [(3.5)² − (0.5)² − 3.5]

Step 1: Calculate the values of squares and cubes.

⇒ 3.5² = 12.25 and 0.5² = 0.25

⇒ 3.5³ = 42.875 and 0.5³ = 0.125

Step 2: Substitute values into the expression.

⇒ Numerator = 42.875 − 0.125 − 8.75 = 42.75 − 8.75 = 34

⇒ Denominator = 12.25 − 0.25 − 3.5 = 12 − 3.5 = 8.5

Step 3: Perform final division.

⇒ Value = 34 ÷ 8.5

⇒ Value = 340 ÷ 85 = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It defines the order of operations: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Algebraic Identities

a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²) and a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).

Decimal Multiplication

When multiplying decimals, multiply as whole numbers and place the decimal point such that the number of decimal places equals the sum of places in the factors.

questions.question: sqrt{10.89} + sqrt{0.1089} + sqrt{0.001089} + sqrt{0.00001089} + sqrt{0.0000001089} = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since √1089 = 33, each root reduces the decimal places by half.

The values are 3.3, 0.33, 0.033, 0.0033, and 0.00033.

Sum = 3.3 + 0.33 + 0.033 + 0.0033 + 0.00033 = 3.66663.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.66663.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: √10.89 + √0.1089 + √0.001089 + √0.00001089 + √0.0000001089

Method: Standard square root simplification and decimal addition.

⇒ √10.89 = √(1089/100) = 33/10 = 3.3

⇒ √0.1089 = √(1089/10000) = 33/100 = 0.33

⇒ √0.001089 = √(1089/1000000) = 33/1000 = 0.033

⇒ √0.00001089 = √(1089/100000000) = 33/10000 = 0.0033

⇒ √0.0000001089 = √(1089/10000000000) = 33/100000 = 0.00033

⇒ Sum = 3.3 + 0.33 + 0.033 + 0.0033 + 0.00033

⇒ Sum = 3.66663

**∴ The correct answer is 3.66663.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Root of Decimals

When taking the square root of a decimal, the number of decimal places in the result is always half the number of decimal places in the original number. For example, √0.01 (2 places) = 0.1 (1 place).

Perfect Square Estimation

To find √1089: it lies between 30² (900) and 40² (1600). Since it ends in 9, the units digit must be 3 or 7. Testing 33 × 33 = 1089 confirms the root is 33.

BODMAS Rule

Always prioritize operations in the order: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

questions.question:
In the given figure, {angle BCD} = 155 degrees and {angle ABC} = 85 degrees. What is the value (in degrees) of {angle BAC} ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/675b9580645529872c7054e2c65d99eac34dc25414c648f975065751c677905c.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the exterior angle theorem, the exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles.

⇒ ∠BAC + ∠ABC = ∠BCD

⇒ ∠BAC = 155° − 85° = 70°

**∴ The correct answer is 70°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

∠BCD = 155° (Exterior angle at vertex C)

∠ABC = 85° (Interior angle at vertex B)

**Formula Used:**

Exterior Angle Theorem: Exterior angle = Sum of two opposite interior angles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3ef42025107e7a3a03c291ed4d731ebf4f06157fffcabd75d49ebd01bfb056c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In triangle ABC, ∠BCD is the exterior angle produced by extending side AC to D.

⇒ ∠BCD = ∠BAC + ∠ABC

⇒ 155° = ∠BAC + 85°

⇒ ∠BAC = 155° − 85°

⇒ ∠BAC = 70°

**∴ The correct answer is 70°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles in any triangle is always 180°. (∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°)

Linear Pair of Angles

Angles on a straight line add up to 180°. Here, interior ∠BCA + exterior ∠BCD = 180°.

Exterior Angle Property

An exterior angle is formed when one side of a triangle is extended; it is always greater than either of the opposite interior angles.

questions.question:
In the given figure, angle PSQ = 125 degrees and angle PRT = 110 degrees. What is the value (in degrees) of angle SPR?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fba347fdce920ec546deb95bd88b54a12469c78833c108144a64daa43127337.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of any two exterior angles of a triangle = 180° + Interior angle of the third vertex.

∠PSQ + ∠PRT = 180° + ∠SPR

125° + 110° = 180° + ∠SPR

235° = 180° + ∠SPR

∠SPR = 235° − 180° = 55°

**∴ The correct answer is 55°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97cffc03acc12ff2cb6b45778ceddc8430b860360f8533631e7fa9f55661e01e.png] 

Given: ∠PSQ = 125° and ∠PRT = 110°

∠PSR and ∠PSQ form a linear pair on line QR.

⇒ ∠PSR + ∠PSQ = 180°

⇒ ∠PSR + 125° = 180°

⇒ ∠PSR = 180° − 125° = 55°

Similarly, ∠PRS and ∠PRT form a linear pair on line ST.

⇒ ∠PRS + ∠PRT = 180°

⇒ ∠PRS + 110° = 180°

⇒ ∠PRS = 180° − 110° = 70°

In ΔSPR, by Angle Sum Property:

⇒ ∠SPR + ∠PSR + ∠PRS = 180°

⇒ ∠SPR + 55° + 70° = 180°

⇒ ∠SPR + 125° = 180°

⇒ ∠SPR = 180° − 125° = 55°

**∴ The correct answer is 55°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exterior Angle Theorem

An exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles. For ΔSPR, ∠PSQ = ∠SPR + ∠PRS.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of a triangle is always 180°.

Linear Pair Axiom

If a ray stands on a line, then the sum of two adjacent angles so formed is 180°.
